text:
sam (support): Heads-up — BetaCorp (acct BC-998) flagged that we can't send their invoice. Procurement insists on an official PO number and vendor tax form before billing. They also asked for a signed SOW. They refuse proforma. Can finance/legal advise?

nisha (finance): @sam thanks — can you paste the email thread? Do they need VAT details (they're EU)? If so, we need VAT ID + PO.

sam (support): Pasted key lines below from customer email: 
> "Our procurement policy requires an official PO with cost center and signed SOW attached before any invoice can be processed. No proforma invoices allowed."
> They attached a vendor onboarding template (PDF).

claire (acct mgr): I chatted with them earlier — they are EU-based (Netherlands). They said reverse-charge VAT applies but procurement still wants PO+SOW. They gave a procurement contact: marlo.procure@betacorp.com.

nisha (finance): Ok — two things we need to confirm: 1) whether they want net (reverse charge) invoice or invoice with VAT; 2) whether our vendor forms + W-9 equivalent are acceptable (we're US entity). I'll loop legal for reverse charge check.

legal (legal): For EU reverse charge we need their valid VAT number on the invoice and an explicit statement. If procurement requires a signed SOW we can include it as an attachment, but finance needs the PO number to map charges. No legal blocker to issuing once VAT/PO present.

procurement-bot: FYI automated check shows no PO number on file for acct BC-998. Recommended next step: collect PO# + VAT ID + signed SOW, upload to vendor portal: https://vendor.redwood/example-upload (customer must supply).

sam (support): Customer is pushing back — they want us to bill immediately for onboarding charges and said finance didn't confirm the VAT/PO requirement earlier. They asked if we can provision a temporary proforma to unblock services.

nisha (finance): We can't issue a final invoice without PO per their procurement. We can provide a proforma/estimate for internal use, but it won't satisfy accounts payable. If customer sends the PO (PDF or PO number) and VAT ID, we can issue the official invoice same day.

claire (acct mgr): I'll email the procurement contact now with a plain checklist to speed things up: 1) PO number, 2) VAT ID (if applicable), 3) Signed SOW (PDF), 4) Vendor tax form. I'll CC finance/legal.

sam (support): Thanks — please post the checklist here and tag me when done. I'll keep the thread updated and offer to jump on a short call with their procurement if they want. :phone:
